correctness.rationale: The assigned matrix M=[[0,u,v],[a,0,u],[0,a,0]] is nonnegative and irreducible even at both feasible endpoints for a,B,c_u,c_r>0. I independently expanded det(tI-M)=t^3-2aut-a^2v. On the budget 2c_u u+c_r v=B, the polynomial at t_*=a c_u/c_r equals a^2(B_*-B)/c_r, B_*=a c_u^3/c_r^2, independent of the split. The unique positive Perron root is respectively below/above t_* on each side of the threshold. Comparing polynomial signs at another split proves strict reversal of monotonicity and the all-splits tie at B=B_*. Endpoints yield radii (a^2B/c_r)^(1/3) and sqrt(aB/c_u); inverting the maximum gives min(c_r r^3/a^2,c_u r^2/a) for the threshold budget. Actual frozen RESULT.md and verify_corridor.py were separately inspected; independent symbolic determinant and anchor identities pass. Regression roots are corroboration, not a proof over all real parameters.
